title: Length of an append
description: Induction splits the goal into a nil case and a cons case; watch each one shrink to nothing.

title: Finding a path in a graph
description: Each step proves one edge is in the graph and walks along it; the path 1 → 2 → 5 → 6 grows edge by edge.

title: Reversing a longer list
description: Repeated reverse rewrites expose how the list changes step by step.

title: Splitting a conjunction
description: The constructor tactic splits a conjunction goal into two separate goals, each solved by reflexivity.
